posts.title: Weeknote 2026.47
posts.description: Enjoying the last week before the holidays start. Trying to finish at least one project, before starting another. In the links: A couple reasons to hate on Amazon, the subway tile monopoly, new signals coming for all NYC subway lines, our impending algorithmic monoculture and more.

posts.title: Weeknote 2026.46
posts.description: I lament that we may see more big outages given the call to "just use AI" at many organizations. I put my Jamulus server control scripts on Github and think about not using Github in the future, possibly. In the links: Apple shuts down their support community and a Brooklyn artist memorializes road crash victims.

posts.title: Weeknote 2026.45
posts.description: A big blue wave, jury duty and ditching 1Password for KeePass. In the links: Vandal proofing mailboxes, setting an underground clock and a humanist gets a religious exemption from using AI.
